tools.description: SQLite command-line shell for database operations and queries
tools.usage:
sqlite3 database.db # Open database
sqlite3 -header -csv database.db 'SELECT * FROM users;' # CSV output
sqlite3 database.db < schema.sql # Execute SQL file
sqlite3 -bail database.db '.dump' > backup.sql # Create backup
sqlite3 ':memory:' # In-memory database
